name: Branwen
source:
An diabolic and moralless girl whose guardian is wanted as a serial killer. Her sweet and pretty exterior hides a practical and calculating mind. To keep her guardian safe, she is willing to do anything.

From [url=https://www.deviantart.com/amiralo/art/Saccharine-a-misleading-sim-date-promotion-poster-460891981]Author's DeviantArt
